Bounded #2755 source delta: configured SDK registers synchronously before asynchronous persisted-identity resolution, passes home-schema admission before identity writes, gates metric/trace export on successful identity, and shares shutdown ownership. Existing destinations, keys, explicit hash/OS fields and default resource detectors are unchanged. Inspected index import order, pinned Resource/NodeSDK/exporter behavior and destination/privacy claims. Executed normal telemetry-module startup with actual chat counter and trace at a loopback OTLP receiver; failed identity refuses payload, incompatible home refuses writes, inert initialization preserves no-I/O, and pending identity shutdown cannot announce export. Both registration and unidentified-export mutations are caught and restored at 9d8deaac67. This is local transport/owner evidence, not deployed collector, packaged or native acceptance.
